items.q: Living Time. It actually was Bill Evans's date, but it was Bill Evans, and George Russell had the band.

ctx.x: Living Time. It actually was Bill Evans's date, but it was Bill Evans, and George Russell had the band. George told me that he got a lot of the ideas from a piece of mine which I had called Schizophrenic. But I think I had another name for it [Stereophrenic]. I can’t remember what I called it first. But it was Schizophenic, and it's where I had experimented with the notion of having the rhythm section play at one tempo and the horns play in another tempo. George said that that gave him the idea of writing those…
